name: misty-explosion
flavor_text: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
effect_text_extend: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp.
effect_text_simple: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%.
